about: ROR (Research Organization Registry): look up research organizations (universities, funders, hospitals, companies and others) and their persistent ROR IDs through the public ROR REST API v2 at api.ror.org. Search, filter, fetch details and match affiliation strings.

commands.summary: Search ROR organizations by keyword or advanced field query, with optional filters (type, status, country, continent) and pagination (20 per page)

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text keyword search across organization names, acronyms, aliases and IDs. Do not combine with --advanced.

params.name: advanced
params.description: Elasticsearch-style field query on ROR fields. Supports wildcards, ranges and AND/OR. Escape reserved characters such as / and : inside values with a backslash. Examples: names.value:Cornell*, locatio

params.name: filter
params.description: Comma-separated field:value pairs. All pairs must match. Fields: types (education, funder, healthcare, company, archive, nonprofit, government, facility, other), status (active, inactive, withdrawn),

params.name: page
params.description: 1-based results page. Each page holds 20 items.

commands.summary: Get the total match count and facet counts (types, countries, continents, statuses) for a ROR search, without the result items

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text keyword search, same as in search-organizations. Do not combine with --advanced.

params.name: advanced
params.description: Elasticsearch-style field query, e.g. names.value:Cornell* or established:[1900 TO 1950]

params.name: filter
params.description: Comma-separated field:value filters, all must match. Fields: types, status, locations.geonames_details.country_code, locations.geonames_details.continent_code. Example: status:active,types:funder or l

commands.summary: Get the full ROR record for one organization by ROR ID: names, locations, external IDs (GRID, ISNI, Wikidata, FundRef), links and parent/child/related relationships

params.name: id
params.description: ROR ID: the 9-character suffix of the ROR URL, e.g. 052gg0110 for https://ror.org/052gg0110

commands.summary: Match a free-text affiliation string (e.g. from a paper's author list) to ROR organizations; returns scored candidates with matching type and a 'chosen' flag for a confident match

params.name: affiliation
params.description: Raw affiliation string, e.g. 'Department of Physics, University of Oxford, UK'
